Real drift is concentrated vault<->repo: 6 live skills never backported (incl. opusclip-shorts edited today), 2 one-sided content edits (repo ahead on ci-silent-pass-lint, vault ahead on deep-research), and a stale vault SKILLS-MANIFEST (-18 rows); plus one uncommitted repo skill. skills-claude-only/ is a dead 2.5-month-old tree (31/36 names reach no live target; microsoft-foundry/qdx-rush copies are old versions) - retire it. Codex deliberately receives nothing from the vault (only 2 hand-copies, one stale); that asymmetry is unenforced-by-anything except absence of a sync step. Two hygiene hits inside the SSOT itself: a 393-file third-party pack under synced/ (provenance UNVERIFIED, actively written 2026-09-16..19) and .ruff_cache/, both junctioned straight into Claude's live skills dir. CRLF phantoms (qdx-rush vault/repo, skill-stocktake vault/codex) were confirmed as non-drift by newline-normalized re-hash.
